title: ndarray 创建、dtype 推导与内存占用
expected_output:
numpy 2.5.3
a = [1 2 3] | dtype = int64
b = [1. 2. 3.] | dtype = float64
c =
[[0 0 0]
 [0 0 0]] | dtype = int32
d =
[[0 1 2]
 [3 4 5]]
e = [0.   0.25 0.5  0.75 1.  ]
--- 内存占用 ---
a itemsize=8 nbytes=24 ndim=1 shape=(3,)
b itemsize=8 nbytes=24 ndim=1 shape=(3,)
c itemsize=4 nbytes=24 ndim=2 shape=(2, 3)
--- 隐式 dtype 推导（宽度向上取齐）---
int + float : float64
bool + int  : int64
int + str   : <U21
code:
import numpy as np
print("numpy", np.__version__)
a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
c = np.zeros((2, 3), dtype=np.int32)
d = np.arange(6).reshape(2, 3)
e = np.linspace(0, 1, 5)
print("a =", a, "| dtype =", a.dtype)
print("b =", b, "| dtype =", b.dtype)
print("c =")
print(c, "| dtype =", c.dtype)
print("d =")
print(d)
print("e =", e)
print("--- 内存占用 ---")
for name, arr in (("a", a), ("b", b), ("c", c)):
    print("%s itemsize=%d nbytes=%d ndim=%d shape=%s"
          % (name, arr.itemsize, arr.nbytes, arr.ndim, arr.shape))
print("--- 隐式 dtype 推导（宽度向上取齐）---")
print("int + float :", np.array([1, 2, 3.5]).dtype)
print("bool + int  :", np.array([True, 1, 2]).dtype)
print("int + str   :", np.array([1, "2"]).dtype)
